decisions.reason: The construction site dumper fits the firm's core construction equipment portfolio and has survived initial screening, so satisfactory results and available slack make dropping unlikely.
The inclined furniture lift serves a narrow niche, so demand uncertainty persists, but slack and specialized service capabilities support keeping it while results remain acceptable.
The inclined building material lift aligns with core lifting and construction applications, suggesting aspirations are met and a drop is unlikely.
The truck-mounted variant is more uncertain but leverages existing lift technology and service strengths, so slack favors keeping it at this stage.
